data.name: 黑土无归
data.detailed_description:
【About This Story】

1998, Northeast China.

Five years ago, Lyu Hansong’s father, a senior engineer, perished in what was ruled a "tragic car accident." But while sorting through his father’s old blueprints, Hansong stumbles upon a set of clandestine notes. They point toward a truth buried deep beneath the snow: his father was not a victim of fate, but a target of a meticulously orchestrated assassination.

As the investigation unfolds, Hansong realizes that the semiconductor technology his father died protecting is the eye of a storm involving powerful, competing factions. A decades-long conspiracy, fueled by greed and systemic upheaval, begins to reveal its jagged teeth amidst the endless snowfall.

【Core Features: Be the Detective】

1. Immersive Investigation: Piece Together the Fragmented Truth

Go beyond simple point-and-click. We provide a comprehensive detective workflow:

  • Crime Scene Search: Explore 1990s-style interiors from a first-person perspective to find details deliberately hidden by the culprit.

  • Forensic Examination: Analyze autopsy reports and visual clues to determine the cause of death, the sequence of events, and the MO. Make the deceased "speak."

  • Witness Interrogation: Engage in psychological warfare with a diverse cast of characters. Detect lies, shatter masks with evidence, and break through the suspects' mental defenses.

  • The Logic Map: Connect gathered clues into a logical chain to reconstruct the crime path and finalize your official case report.

2. Human Nature in the Shadows: A Moral Crossroad

In an era of drastic transition, the truth is often a bitter pill.

Why did the killer strike? Was it to secure a patent that could rewrite history, or a desperate act of self-preservation within a collapsing system? In the clash between interest and survival, there are no absolute heroes.

When justice, law, and reality collide, where will you stand?

3. Five Interconnected Cases

The game features five independent yet subtly linked suspense cases, meticulously recreating the atmosphere of 1998 Northeast China:

  • Industrial Noir Atmosphere: From rusted pager factories and steamy public bathhouses to desolate midnight train stations. Experience the grit, passion, and uncertainty of an era in transition.

  • Hardcore Tech Background: Based on the real historical trajectory of the early chip industry. You aren't just solving a crime; you are witnessing the struggle of a generation of engineers against the tides of time.

  • Authentic Social Fabric: Vivid NPCs and localized dialogue bring to life the unique warmth and cruelty of this frozen land.

“The heavy snow will eventually melt, but the tracks left by history are eternal.”
